goal: Inventory text, helper and capability reuse opportunities and authorize only reuse patterns with demonstrated maintenance value

guide_delta.summary: Wiederkehrende sichtbare Begriffe dürfen später zentral verwaltet werden. Normale Funktionen bleiben normale Python-Funktionen; eine dynamische Capability-Registry wird erst eingeführt, wenn wirklich austauschbare oder optionale Komponenten existieren.

tests_explicitly_not_run: product tests because no product code changes
TUI/browser tests because runtime code is untouched
database/domain/repository regressions because frozen core is untouched
visual evidence because no UI changes exist
risks: over-centralizing one-off text would reduce readability instead of improving maintenance
a generic helper module could become a dumping ground unless extraction requires real repeated semantics
a dynamic capability registry would add indirection and weaken static typing before there is a concrete plugin or optional-runtime need
expected_side_effects: future shared user-visible semantic labels may be centralized behind stable text IDs with registry-level versioning
future helper extraction requires at least two real consumers of the same pure semantic operation
capability resolution remains Protocol/import based until a real dynamic optionality requirement is demonstrated
